Delivered the **unsuccessful POC within the inspected scope** in [delivery.md](../docs/research/poc/delivery.md) and [delivery.json](../docs/research/poc/delivery.json).

The unchanged original is [artifacts/poc-original.vi](artifacts/poc-original.vi), copied from `@environment/pylavi/tests/add.vi` at pylavi revision `35d2a0318f71dcb87bb9c431dc00700ee6b9fb75` (Unlicense).

[Verification record](../docs/research/poc/delivery-verification.json) retains the separate original-copy hash check and successful original-inspector reproduction.
`python3 -I docs/research/poc/verify_delivery.py` passes: 13 criteria, 38 pinned files, two exits and nine negative checks; the existing readiness verifier also passes its partial verdict.
The final check passed with `LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT` unset, before this report existed, and with parent-verifier session/prepared-source reads denied.
Passing validates failure-delivery consistency only; original binary session artifacts are not offline dependencies.
All existing POC evidence, verifiers and README remain byte-for-byte unchanged; no product implementation or benchmark changes were made.
The delivery explains semantic, DTHP/VCTP/ConstValue, BDPW and compiled-cache blockers and offers controlled same-version fixtures or missing pinned source rules as concrete exits.
Owner instructions inspect the original only; no broken arrow, requested behavior and preserved save version remain outstanding checks for a future changed VI.
The requested loop-state file was absent (`FileNotFoundError`) and history contained zero records; the committed goal and saved working memory supplied explicit scope, without inventing session state.

## What next
Return to benchmark preparation after this delivery without waiting for owner action. Read role/readiness contracts, preparation status and relevant actual paused-thread evidence linked in the delivery before selecting benchmark work; avoid repeating RSRC research, unsupported 103/104 semantics or declined #430 unchanged. Owner silence is not acceptance, and this delivery does not claim the project goal achieved.
